# Tern

> Encrypted messaging in 466 KB. No phone number. Built for weak networks.

Tern is a tiny end-to-end encrypted messenger from Nomli Tech Limited.
Public site pages (all crawlable):

- [Home](https://nlite.nomli.cc/): product overview and size claims
- [Privacy](https://nlite.nomli.cc/privacy/): how data is handled
- [Terms](https://nlite.nomli.cc/terms/): terms of use

Contact: dev@niilox.com
